rule_that_would_catch_it: Shape and co-occurrence rule: exposed bars need rust inside a spall rim and a linear shape (minAreaRect aspect above 3); rust with no spall rim is corrosion. Where two classes clear the threshold on one region, send it to human review instead of choosing. The rust-near-spall part exists; the review-on-ambiguity step does not.
